name: Katsura Kogorou
source:
"It's doesn't mean we want to start a war"
A warrior of the anti-western Choushuu, he's often known by his nickname of 'Getaway Kogorou'.
A moderate guy who doesn't like fighting.
His friends and hometown are the most important things to him.
